title: Senior Techno-Functional Oracle Integration Specialist
jobDescription:
responsibilities will include: Develop integrations for Oracle Fusion Cloud and its connections with third-party applications. Develop and administer reports and dashboards using Oracle Fusion Cloud tools. Document processes, applications, and integrations to build connections between finance systems through APIs. Support all testing activities, including integration, end-to-end, and UAT. Improve by identifying process gaps and applying new platform features. Participate in the quarterly Oracle Fusion systems upgrade. Read more Skills you need   Must-Haves We are looking for a candidate with at least 5 years of technical experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud, specifically in the Financials and SCM modules. Oracle Integration Expertise: Experience building bulk integrations in OIC, developing ERP integration scenarios for end-to-end data flows, and creating FBDI-based data migrations using the Oracle ERP Adapter. VBCS & App Development: Demonstrated knowledge of VBCS and practical experience building VBCS apps. Oracle Technical Skills: Expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, with the ability to write, debug, and tune complex queries. Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion tables, views, and setups. Analytics: Experience enhancing standard Oracle reports and building custom reports using BI Publisher, OTBI, and Smart View. Analytical skills to translate requirements into technical specifications for reports. Additional Skills: Experience with web services (SOAP, REST API), configuration management tools (SVN, Git Lab), and building CI/CD pipelines.   Nice-to-Haves Coding: Knowledge of Python and Groovy Script. Knowledge: Experience with Finance functional modules (P2P, O2C, R2R). Workato: Experience building integrations/APIs using Workato. Oracle Paa S: Knowledge of Oracle Paa S technologies, ATP databases Read more What we offer   About Grab and Our Workplace Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility. Read more Life at Grab   Life at Grab We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer: We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance. With Grab Flex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations. Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges. Balance personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our Flex Work arrangements such as creative hours   What We Stand For at Grab We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.
